messages:
SupportBot: 🚨 ALERT: AcmeCorp production showing repeated 504s from hosted inference gateway. spike in request_queue_depth to 48 on us-east-1, continuous-batcher backlog growing. Summary: p95 latency 1.2s -> p99 12.1s, 504 tail timeouts increasing since 00:12 UTC. Ticket #INC-49321.
Sam H: ack — pinging SRE-OnCall and Eng-Platform. Any immediate mitigation?
SRE-OnCall: looking. Can you paste a sample request id or trace? need gateway logs + batcher metrics.
SupportBot: sample_request_id: r-9f3a2b; gateway logs (excerpt): `ERROR gateway: request_queue_reject: depth=48 limit=50; dequeue_timeout=30s; downstream 504`.
Maria G: thanks. Early hypothesis: continuous batching backlog + long KV-cache cold fills from a heavy long-seq tenant causing queue head-of-line. Could be per-tenant imbalance. Is Acme on dedicated or hosted?
Sam H: hosted. Customer says issue started after a rollout at ~23:50 UTC (more concurrent long-context evals).
Lee W: I see a short-term spike of long_seq requests from tenant acme-corp between 23:48-00:06 UTC — length distribution skewed to 8k tokens. Batcher configured for concurrency=64, max_queue_depth=50. When many long requests hit, batching stalls and tail latency explodes.
SRE-OnCall: reproduce steps pls. Would like curl sample.
Sam H: customer provided this curl (sanitized):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${KEY}" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-7b","input":"<8k tokens>","stream":false}'
```
Maria G: repro locally with a small script sending ~200 concurrent long requests. I can repro queue depth climbing and p99 > 10s. Stacktrace points to continuous-batcher waiting on kv-cache lookups and a stalled dequeue due to backpressure.
Lee W: immediate mitigation options:
- enable model-fallback for Acme to a smaller quantized variant (rwd-7b-q4) to shorten exec time
- temporarily raise max_queue_depth to 80 for hosted gateway (risk: memory/backpressure)
- apply per-tenant rate limit on long_seq requests (throttle longer than 4k tokens)
Which do we want to try first?
SRE-OnCall: try model-fallback + short-term throttle on long requests. Coordinate with Customer Success.
Sam H: notifying Acme support rep. Maria, can you run a canary config to enable fallback for acme-corp only? Keep telemetry.
Maria G: on it — will flip routing rule to prefer rwd-7b-q4 for tenant acme-corp and add tag `fallback-experiment-49321`. Will monitor.
SupportBot: CONFIG_CHANGE: routing rule applied to tenant=acme-corp at 00:28 UTC by Maria G.
Sam H: customer confirms reduced 504s within 4m of the change, p99 dropped from 12s -> 2.1s. Good.
Lee W: follow ups: need a longer-term plan — suggestions:
- add adaptive batching policy: detect long-seq heavy workload and shift into separate long-batcher pool to avoid head-of-line blocking
- expose per-tenant long-seq quotas and server-side rejections (405 with retry-after) instead of letting queue saturate
- KV-cache prewarm heuristics for tenants with frequent long contexts
SRE-OnCall: agree. Create follow-up action items and link to runbook.
Sam H: creating postmortem and customer update. Draft notes: root cause = tenant-driven burst of long-context requests that saturated continuous batching queue, causing dequeue stalls and tail timeouts. Temporary mitigation = tenant-specific model-fallback + throttle.
Maria G: I'll add an eval to Redwood Optimize to detect similar regressions in the future and include a guardrail for model selection when queue depth > 40.
SRE-OnCall: assigning owners: Maria -> rollout rules + telemetry, Lee -> batching policy design, Sam -> customer comms, SRE-OnCall -> runbook updates.
Sam H: tagging #postmortems and linking ticket INC-49321. Thanks team :thumbsup:
